report_name: Industry Leaders Warn AI-Powered Attacks Are Outpacing Defenses

threat_actors.name: AI-assisted Threat Actors
threat_actors.description: A class of threat actors who leverage artificial intelligence as a force multiplier to increase the speed, scale, and autonomy of their attacks. These actors are capable of identifying vulnerabilities, crafting exploits, and executing attacks with minimal human intervention.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: Attackers are targeting the AI development lifecycle itself, creating a systemic supply chain vulnerability.

attack_patterns.name: Poison Training Data
attack_patterns.description: Threat actors seek to poison AI training data as a primary vector for supply chain compromise, creating widespread downstream risk before models are deployed.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Exfiltration
attack_patterns.description: AI was used to accelerate an attack on Spain's rail network, enabling the exfiltration of 500 GB of data in a few hours.

attack_patterns.name: Obtain Capabilities: Artificial Intelligence
attack_patterns.description: Malicious actors were reported to be using commercial AI models, such as Anthropic's Claude, to support their cyber operations.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: A commercial AI model from Anthropic that was reported as being abused by malicious actors for cyber operations between late 2025 and August 2026.

identities.name: StrongKeep Cybersecurity
identities.description: Company whose CEO, Gaurav Keerthi, commented on the evolving AI threat landscape at the Asia New Vision Forum.

identities.name: Anthropic
identities.description: AI company that reported on its efforts to disrupt the malicious use of its Claude AI models for cyber operations.

identities.name: Gaurav Keerthi
identities.description: CEO of StrongKeep Cybersecurity who warned that AI-powered attacks are outpacing defensive capabilities.

identities.name: Spanish Rail Network
identities.description: Victim of an AI-assisted cyberattack where attackers exfiltrated 500 GB of data.
